purpose: Role-readable downstream/control state synchronized to O_CHAT control7 for 19-role Work-outcome-to-Chat Phase 1, active integrator coordination, Chat exact-blob fallback and re-enable-only scheduler repair.

baseline_non_regression.rule: Preserve every prior safety, CLEAN independence, continuation, recovery, exact-scope, identity, CAS/readback, wave/feed and primary-O boundary as baseline/fallback. Phase-1 assignments are additive current work.

authority_bootstrap.preferred: SHA-only H1, exact-H1 root/downstream, SHA-only H2 before semantic work, then freeze.

chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.use_only_when: a SHA-only refs/heads/main lookup is not exposed in the scheduled Chat connector
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.pass_1: fetch every role-approved authoritative path and record the exact returned Git blob SHA plus parsed revision; consume no other semantic input
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.pass_2: immediately before the first role-local/public semantic read, fetch the same authoritative paths again in the same order
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.valid_when: all path/blob/revision tuples and cross-control references are identical, no forbidden semantic input was consumed, and no own-state CAS/input conflict exists
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.freeze: freeze the verified path/blob/revision tuple for the invocation and record transport_mode=exact_blob_two_pass
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.post_freeze: unrelated main movement is not a stop; later checks may compare only the frozen authoritative paths/blobs
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.failure: write diagnostic checkpoint and exact continuation, keep the recurring task enabled, and retry next invocation; never self-disable
chat_exact_blob_two_pass_fallback.aba_guard: monotonic control/config revisions and cross-file control references must agree; rollback or mismatch is fail-closed

authority_bootstrap.receipt: Every receipt binds exact frozen root/downstream/role path, blob, parsed revisions, transport mode, bootstrap_valid and continuation.
authority_bootstrap.invalid: Mismatch or unverifiable binding is diagnostic-only and cannot drive state-changing writes or Phase-1 acceptance.

policy.clean_independence: Downstream may consume only permitted clean outputs; never expose O, other-worker or downstream semantics to CLEAN explorers and never write explorer state/feedback.
policy.primary_o_boundary: No role here may acquire or alter primary O lease/fence/frozen request/protected execution state, direct-merge main or become a duplicate primary writer.
policy.identity_and_scope: Use exact source-qualified identity and tested scope; no fuzzy joins; omitted evidence is not assessed.
policy.wave_and_feed_integrity: Integrator is active and remains sole ACTIVE_WAVE/index/feed coordinator. Preserve valid incomplete waves; require exact source pre/postflight, bootstrap_valid, current-blob CAS, full readback, lossless history and immutable own receipt.
policy.anti_stop: One result, checkpoint, no-change or blocker is never global completion. During Phase 1, completed/blocked/duplicate/low-value leaves are reassigned inside Phase 1 rather than restoring base work.

scheduler_boundary.workers: Recurring enabled state is preserved across invocation boundaries, no-result runs, missing SHA-only refs and blockers.
scheduler_boundary.optimizer: May only re-enable an intended enabled_desired role after the concrete cause is repaired and read back; never disables, pauses or deletes managed roles.

phase1.no_restore: Complete/block/low-value means checkpoint and reassign within Phase 1.

phase1_assignment.directive: Verify highest-value Work-to-Chat route and capability claims against primary sources and exact Chat/repository evidence. Preserve exact scope; do not steer CLEAN explorers or mutate O.

primary_source_verifier.policy: Apply global policy and current Phase-1 assignment; use SHA-only bootstrap or exact-blob two-pass fallback; checkpoint and reassign within Phase 1; preserve recurring enabled state; enforce exact identity/scope/CAS/readback and protected-primary boundaries.

phase1_assignment.directive: Mechanically test whether proposed Work-to-Chat routes are reproducible with actually available Chat tools. Classify direct Chat, missing dependency, unavailable, Work-exclusive and protected-primary-only actions.

reproducibility_auditor.policy: Apply global policy and current Phase-1 assignment; use SHA-only bootstrap or exact-blob two-pass fallback; checkpoint and reassign within Phase 1; preserve recurring enabled state; enforce exact identity/scope/CAS/readback and protected-primary boundaries.

phase1_assignment.directive: Deduplicate and compare Work-to-Chat mechanisms by exact source identity and tested scope; prioritize distinct route coverage over unrelated normal-pipeline expansion.

o_novelty_comparator.policy: Apply global policy and current Phase-1 assignment; use SHA-only bootstrap or exact-blob two-pass fallback; checkpoint and reassign within Phase 1; preserve recurring enabled state; enforce exact identity/scope/CAS/readback and protected-primary boundaries.

phase1_assignment.directive: Independently grade the 19 role cells, Work-to-Chat route matrix and aggregate controls. Duplicate-effect and low-usefulness negative controls must fail; matched positive may pass only when every hard gate holds.

evidence_comparator.policy: Apply global policy and current Phase-1 assignment; use SHA-only bootstrap or exact-blob two-pass fallback; checkpoint and reassign within Phase 1; preserve recurring enabled state; enforce exact identity/scope/CAS/readback and protected-primary boundaries.

phase1_assignment.directive: Maintain the 19-cell acceptance matrix, recursive problem tree and Work-to-Chat route matrix from valid current or mechanically assignment-equivalent evidence. Remain sole ACTIVE_WAVE/index/feed coordinator and preserve existing wave/feed state.

integrator.policy: Apply global policy and current Phase-1 assignment; use SHA-only bootstrap or exact-blob two-pass fallback; checkpoint and reassign within Phase 1; preserve recurring enabled state; enforce exact identity/scope/CAS/readback and protected-primary boundaries.

phase1_assignment.directive: Classify and package only genuinely irreducible Work-exclusive or protected-primary actions, proving that available Chat-capable work was not handed off unnecessarily. Preserve feed and CAS/readback safety.

bridge.policy: Apply global policy and current Phase-1 assignment; use SHA-only bootstrap or exact-blob two-pass fallback; checkpoint and reassign within Phase 1; preserve recurring enabled state; enforce exact identity/scope/CAS/readback and protected-primary boundaries.

phase1_assignment.directive: Maintain the 19-role role-and-method portfolio, synchronize role-readable control, repair stop causes, perform re-enable-only reconciliation for reasoning, independently rederive all role/matrix/aggregate gates, and never become a primary O writer.

automation_optimizer.policy: Apply global policy and current Phase-1 assignment; use SHA-only bootstrap or exact-blob two-pass fallback; checkpoint and reassign within Phase 1; preserve recurring enabled state; enforce exact identity/scope/CAS/readback and protected-primary boundaries.

scheduler_reconciliation.allowed_action: re-enable reasoning only after repaired controls are frozen and enabled_desired/intended membership/no-user-stop/capacity are verified
scheduler_reconciliation.on_missing_surface: persist pending and retry; Phase 1 cannot close

work_delegation_gate.reason: The 19 intended roles plus protected O monitor fill the 20-active-task cap; optimizer fallback covers at most one bounded gate-owned unit per optimizer invocation.
work_delegation_gate.policy: Standby only; do not displace an intended Phase-1 role. Preserve base queue/results. If later capacity is explicitly available, controller may enable without disabling another role.

migration.reason: Recheck found downstream control still described a 14-role pool and inactive integrator after physical re-enable. Control30 synchronizes the 19-role route-matrix objective and repairs the Chat bootstrap/self-stop gap.
migration.rollback_condition: Only independently proven authority, identity, wave/feed or CLEAN-isolation failure; never roll back by shrinking the pool, restoring the hard SHA-only-ref dependency or allowing role self-disable.
